specs.derived_from: Owner earnings, incremental returns, or reinvestment runway fall below the low-case bridge.
specs.rationale: Types the owner-earnings leg of the prose falsifier for the filing-locked healthcare REIT stub. Threshold is the low-case proof-trace owner_earnings anchor ($357M: FY2025 operating cash flow $1,252M minus $895M property investments per 10-K). A resolved normalized owner earnings value below this anchor means cash generation has fallen below the low-case bridge. Incremental returns and reinvestment runway are judgment inputs without a resolvable metric in base proof.
